_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: 新しいクエスト開始: {p} の魔女裁判

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of dark magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: {p} の中に敵がいる！この魔女の違法な魔法が我らを脅かしているのだ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued with spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: Amira 氏の家は広がる腐朽に侵されていた！我らの神聖を守るため、魔女を殺さねばならん！
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker:
The Mayor
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Further...intruders...? You are not of the worms...the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: …さらなる… 侵入者…？お前は虫ども… 寄生虫の仲間ではないのか？
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scorches us. There is no place to go, no place we can burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: 日の光が我らを焼くゆえ、逃げられぬ。行く場所も、奴らが待ち構えぬ掘り場もない。
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive til this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: お前は… お前は… 命を持っている。心臓も、筋肉も、肉も… この責め苦が終わるまで生き延びるための…
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: You're stuck! Maybe you can dig yourself out?
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: はまってしまった！掘って抜け出せるかもしれない？
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: À

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: It seems like the creature was knocked out. Now is the time to catch it! The cage seems like a good place to keep it.
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: あの生き物は気を失ったようだ。今こそ捕まえる時！あの籠は閉じ込めておくのに良さそうだ。
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: À

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: 何かおかしい気がする……

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: The creature is out of control!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: あの生き物が暴れ出した！

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: It seemed like the creature calmed down... You should show the mayor to free Amira.
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: あの生き物は落ち着いたようだ……市長に見せて Amira を解放してもらうべきだ。

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: ...Fine then. This...creature...bug...leech? This whatever-it-is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.dst: …分かった。この… 生き物… 虫… ヒル？この得体の知れんものは… 説明を受け入れよう。
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just...took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.dst: ふん、ようやくか！やっと分かってきたな！まるで何かがある日……お前に取り憑いて、今までずっと離れなかったみたいだ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: As for the...THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.dst: それであの……あれだが……まあ……Gavel の政府には必ず知らせておく。
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: 逃げられる前にあの生き物を追いかけて！

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で {p} の中心で何が起きているか確かめる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: 待って！いい加減放してよ！何が起きたか説明したでしょ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: 闇の魔術の欺きなど通じんぞ、Amira 氏。大人しく去れ――我らを放っておけ！
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: いい加減黙って！こんな風に人を名指しで吊るし上げないでよ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#021.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#021.dst: ちょっとでいいから聞いて！私じゃない、何かが家に取り憑いたの！だからあんなに暗かったのよ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#021.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.dst: 地下室よ、何か変なものが掘り進んできたの！そいつが通った所は枯れて腐朽したの！
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.dst: 私じゃない証拠は家にあるわ！腐朽して荒れ果てたのはあっちよ！見ればわかるわ、この血に飢えた奴！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: 罵るのはやめろ！ひとまず延期だ――魔女の無実の証拠がなければ処刑する！
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: 腐朽して荒れ果てた家の地下室を調べる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: トンネルを進んで生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルから引き続き生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: また余所者か… トンネルを見ただろう。奴らは石を蝕み、根を枯らし、大地から命を奪う…
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: そして我らはここで孤立し飢えている。大地そのものが歪み動く中、我が民は迷うばかり。
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: 水は淀み灰色。あの忌まわしい魔法の災いと、虫そのものしか糧がない。
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#035.dst: 余所者よ、死んでもらう。
Lexdale Witch Trials#035.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#036.dst: トンネル住人の族長を倒す。

Lexdale Witch Trials#037.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#037.dst: 待て… この地震は！奴らだ！ぐああああああ！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#037.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#038.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#038.dst: 土から自力で抜け出し、生き物を追う。

Lexdale Witch Trials#039.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#039.dst: {p} に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で町長に生き物を見せる。

Lexdale Witch Trials#040.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#040.dst: 戻ったか。どうだっ――待て、一体「それ」は何だ？！
Lexdale Witch Trials#040.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#041.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#041.dst: それ！それが私の地下室にいたやつよ！！あの人間なら見つけられると思ってた！ありがとう！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#041.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#042.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#042.dst: こいつが家中に腐朽を広げてたのよ！あんたがある日突然「決めつけた」魔女や魔法なんかじゃない！！
Lexdale Witch Trials#042.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#044.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#044.dst: 壇から降りなさい、Amira 氏。あなたは無実だ。
Lexdale Witch Trials#044.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#046.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#046.dst: …む。それは… うむ。ともかく。人間よ、信頼に足ると証明したな。我らの門はお前に開かれている。
Lexdale Witch Trials#046.speaker: The Mayor
